name: manual_4cfad1
claim: start.ps1 must be run with --lan-peer (not just --no-open) for LAN cross-machine coordination to actually work -- without it, PT/orama/Portal stay bound to localhost only, and the control-plane token never gets synced from PT's persisted state.

decisions.notes: An entire session's worth of cross-machine auth failures (401s on portal-status, ws-peer) traced back to running start.ps1 --no-open exclusively -- LAN bind was never enabled, so the Mac could never reach this box's services, and vice versa. Only after restarting with --lan-peer --no-open did the peer probe have any chance of succeeding.

rationale: An entire session's worth of cross-machine auth failures (401s on portal-status, ws-peer) traced back to running start.ps1 --no-open exclusively -- LAN bind was never enabled, so the Mac could never reach this box's services, and vice versa. Only after restarting with --lan-peer --no-open did the peer probe have any chance of succeeding.
